FOREIGN COUNTRIES

Tabeer Tours makes traveling abroad simple and stress-free with expert international visa services for countries beyond the U.A.E. Submit your inquiry today and save time

VISA APPLICATION PROCESS
HOW TO APPLY FOR UAE VISA

STEP- 1: SELECT THE COUNTRY YOU WANT TO VISIT

  • After selecting the country which you are planning to visit
  • Choose type of Visa – For example: 30 Days UAE Visa / 30 Days Tourist Visa
  • Choose your Nationality / visitor’s nationality

Click the Search button, you will be redirected to the details page. Fill information about the visa fees. Deposit amount if applicable. Write type of visa, number of applications and the total amount you need to pay to continue with the application process.

STEP- 2: APPLICATION PROCESS

  • Verify the Type of Visa, No of Applicants, Visa Fees, Security amount if applicable and the total amount to be paid and confirm all steps.
  • Write complete Visitor details like First Name, Last Name and Nationality
  • Write your / Guarantor details – Name, Email Address and Mobile Number
  • Now click on “Continue” button to move to payment section
  • Go through the payment options. Read and accept the Terms and Conditions. Click on “Pay Now” button to do the payment.
  • Once payment is done, you will get confirmation email.
  • In order to check visa status, log into your account and find status under My Trips.

STEP- 3: SUBMIT DOCUMENTS

  • Email us your and visitor’s passport details at info@gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com. In subject kindly mention your Visa Trip ID. Visa Trip ID can be find on the email we have sent you after you made payment successfully
  • After verification of documents and payment by our team, we will generate your visa application form. The Visa generated form would be sent to the immigration department.
  • Notice would be sent to you once your application gets approval /rejection from immigration department.
  • After the visa application approval, Waytransit Travels & Tourism will generate E-Visa. It would be sent to you via email after verification of all steps i.e. documentation and payment
  • You can Log in to the website using the User ID and Password to download the E-Visa

Kindly Note: All visas issued online will be E-Visas. If you want to get original copy, you can get by paying additional fee. A copy of E-Visa shall be provided to the customer once a round trip ticket is purchased through either our website or through Call Center / branch network else an additional service charge of AED 100 will be charged. In order to Cancel an issued visa, request can be made at an additional fee subjected to the conditions imposed by immigration department. Once your visa is approved the visa copy will be uploaded on the My Trips. You can download your E-Visa copy online by logging in to gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com with your registered email and password. Upon receiving the E-Visa, we recommend you to check all the details mentioned in the visa copy and in case of any query please contact us immediately by emailing us at info@gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com. It is requested to fill in all details correctly. Incorrect details may lead to visa rejection by the Immigration officer. Waytransit Travels & Tourism will not be liable for any rejection. Visitors are advised to carefully go through the “Note” printed on the visa document for “Visa Validity and Duration of Stay”.

For further queries please contact us at:
Email ID: info@gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com
Telephone: + 971 43 575 404

DOCUMENT REQUIRED
VISITOR’S DOCUMENTS

Terms and Conditions for Visitors Documents

  • Passport Copy: Visitors are requested to submit Passport copy that must be clear and it’s better to give colored copy.
  • Passport Validity: Passport should be valid for at least six months at the date of visa application.
  • Photograph: Passport size colored photograph with white background is required.

Photograph: One clear passport size colour photograph with white background.

Note: Additional documents may be required by the immigration authorities which we will communicate to you through the Email ID /Contact number provided by you.

Terms and Conditions for Visa Application

GUARANTOR’S DOCUMENTS

  • Passport Copy: Guarantors are requested to submit Passport copy that must be clear and it’s preferable to give colored copy.
  • Passport Validity: Passport should be valid for at least six months at the date of visa application.
GUARANTOR’S RESIDENCE VISA COPY WITH MINIMUM OF THREE MONTHS VALIDITY
Guarantor’s valid email address and phone number

Waytransit Travels & Tourism hereby declares that we have no role in the assessment of a visa application, which is the sole prerogative of the government of Immigration department of the visa processing country. Therefore, Waytransit Travels & Tourism will not in any manner be liable or responsible for any delay in the processing or rejection of any visa application.

Tourist who wish to visit country can now visit freely by fulfilling conditions imposed by Immigration authorities. Visit Visa can be rejected/ accepted solely by the decision of government of visa issuing country.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism will sponsor the visitor application only if the visitor is having original documents and fulfilling eligibility criteria. Visa fees is non-refundable and the applicant/visitor will not make any claims to refund for any reason whatsoever. Visitors must hold valid travel documents and comply with the requirements of the government immigration authorities.

In case of rejection of visa application, the applicant will be informed of the same and no correspondence will be entertained. As advised above, visa fees will not be refunded and no reasons will be required to be given.

It is understood that whenever the processing of the visa application is prevented, delayed, restricted or interfered with for any reasons by the immigration authorities to process visitor application, then Waytransit Travels & Tourism will not be liable to any loss or damage which may be suffered as result of such causes. Issuance of a visa or approval of the visa application does not in any way guarantee the visitor right to enter the country of visit. The entry is at the sole discretion of the Immigration authorities.

The visa must be availed within its period of validity. Waytransit Travels & Tourism will not be liable to a visitor for any changes or cancellations to government regulations that should result in a visitor not being able to travel to or enter the country.

Waytransit Travels & Tourism will take all reasonable measures to ensure that the information provided by the guarantor/visitor in its application form will remain confidential. However, Waytransit Travels & Tourism will not be liable for any unauthorized access by any means to that information. Guarantee deposit amount should be collected any time within one year from the date of deposit. Upon expiry of the above said duration, the security deposit will not be refunded to the guarantor.

Visit visas issued online would be E-Visas however, an original copy can be requested for an additional fee. A copy of E-Visa shall be provided to the customer once a round trip ticket is purchased through either our website or through Call Center / branch network else an additional service charge of AED 100 or equivalent will be charged. Issued visa can be made cancel upon request by paying extra fee as per conditions of immigration department.

If any crime takes place during the visit of the traveler sponsored by us the police department of the country will deal them. In case if they are imprisoned or if the immigration system shows an overstay the guarantor shall be solely responsible for the penalties and liabilities. Waytransit Travels & Tourism has full authority to take necessary action against the guarantor. Waytransit Travels & Tourism reserves the right to change the terms and conditions at its discretion and without prior notice.

UNDERTAKING:

You are requested to apply for a visa maximum 58 days before travel, or a minimum of seven working days before you travel. Its recommended to apply for visa in advance of travel.

The Decision to grant entry visa is entirely at the discretion of the country’s immigration authorities. Waytransit tours can’t guarantee your visa application will be accepted.
If I get a visa, am I guaranteed entry in to the Country?

The granting of a visa does not guarantee entry in to the country for which you have applied for the visit visa. The final decision solely depends upon decision made by the immigration officer.

How long does it take to get a visa?If all required documents are submitted successfully, visa is normally issued within 5 working days.

Do I have to pay any security deposit?Security deposit is applicable depending on the merit of your application, nationality and type of visa. Our visa operations team will assist you if any security deposit is required.

When will my security deposit be refunded?As the visitor exits the country and the immigration authorities record the visitor’s departure, security deposit would be refunded within four international working days. In order to provide proof of departure, please check exit stamp on your passport. For rejected applications, the security deposit will be refunded within six working days of the application being rejected. Please note if you paid by credit card, you can mail us at accounts@gulf oasisours.com or call us on our 24/7 help line + 971 43 575 404 .Our representative will assist you.

What documents do I need to apply for visa? Do all family members need to submit documents?Please click on Documents Required for the details. Yes, all family members need to submit documents.

My passport is expiring soon – can I still get a visa?The immigration office requires all visitors to have a passport that is valid for at least six months from the date of arrival. If your passport is valid for less than six months, you will need to renew it before you can apply for a visa and travel to the desired country.

Do children or infants need a visa?Yes, all passengers including children and infants on a parent’s passport, must have a valid visa to enter the country. Children below 18 are required to have visa with them. Sometimes, Immigration department waves off visa condition for parents carrying infants with them.

How can I track the status of my visa application?When you complete your visa application, you will receive the TRIP ID. You need to Log in to your account and in the My Trips section you can find your visa application with the latest status. We will also notify you through email once your visa application has been approved, rejected or if additional information is required.

Why was my visa application rejected?Visa Application is accepted/rejected by the decision of Immigration department. There is no influence of travelling agent on it. However, we can assist you after knowing the root cause of visa application rejection. Our team is professional and they do screening first by their own before sending to immigration department. That’s why our success rate is 99.9 %.

Does the visa fee include credit card charges?No, visa fee is exclusive of credit card charges. Credit card charges will be charged separately.

Will my visa fees be refunded if my application is rejected?Visa fees is not refundable; however, we will refund the deposit amount.

How can I contact Visa department?You may contact us at info@gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com or call us at + 971 43 575 404.

I hereby undertake full responsibility for the applicant who will be entering the country on visit visa sponsored by GULF OASIS TRAVELS & TOURISM LLC (gulfoasistravelsandtourism.com is the online wing for Waytransit Travels & Tourism) and that he/she will leave the country within the stipulated period depending on the visa issued, from the date of arrival. In the event of a default of this condition, I will forfeit the guarantee deposit and bear all legal consequences. I will be solely responsible for any expenses related to his travel, accommodation or other expenses.
